frame.name: Soaring Fang
frame.description:
Dealing damage while grounded charges antigrav repulsors. Dealing damage while airborne extends antigrav repulsors.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  to disengage antigrav repulsors.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Swooping Talons
perks.description: Dealing damage while airborne increases this weapon's damage output.

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

catalyst.name: The Manticore Catalyst
catalyst.description: While you are airborne, sustained damage and final blows with this weapon to difficult combatants grant a Void overshield, reduce combatant accuracy, and return ammo to the magazine.
